notes.title: Area 51 assault and discount
notes.notes:
This event was created on Facebook and is gaining serious momentum, because there are already a lot of people who want to raid this legendary and mysterious base.

Do not miss the chance to take part in the storming of this legendary area 51. The discount is valid until September 22.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes: A small change in scripts. Now when opponents notice you, you have a chance to run away or freeze the enemy within 1 second.

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes: Added extra level that will open after passing the first. In a new level you need to fight back from storming the zone. The goal of the level is to hold out for 4 minutes, you cannot allow penetration to the base.
